events.title: H29 spatial screen reviewed and carried forward
events.detail: The prior main-branch H29 run tested worm gating, worm-ranked emission, persistence-as-head-features and thermal-probe features. No arm passed the frozen +0.005 catalogue-gap proxy screen. Draws 2–3 were nevertheless computed for all arms; because the screens failed they are exploratory extras, not eligible confirmations. The original gate snapshot also omitted those draws due a serialization bug; the raw cells are reconciled in knowledge/06_h29_gate_reconciliation_2026-10-03.md. No weekly slot was recommended or used. This is not a competition score. See knowledge/02_h29_results_2026-10-03.md and evidence/h29_gate_reconciled.json. H31 remains unfit and unscored.

events.title: Candidate ranking revised after H29 prior-work review
events.detail: The pre-sync H31 slate predated discovery of H29 on the advanced main branch. H29 already tested raw-RTP/gravity worm persistence; all four arms failed the registered +0.005 catalogue-gap screen. Draws 2–3 were run for all arms but are exploratory, not valid conditional confirmations, and the original gate snapshot had a serialization bug. H31 remains only an unfitted regularized pseudogravity-transform plus edge-drift extension; H32 terrain-shape asymmetry is now the first unimplemented candidate, and H33 stays blocked pending official flight-path data validation. See knowledge/01_candidates_ranked_2026-10-03.md, knowledge/04_prior_work_audit.md and knowledge/06_h29_gate_reconciliation_2026-10-03.md.
